name: io.github.jayjodev/vivory-mcp-verification
title: Vivory Verification Gateway
description: 45 MCP tools for verifiable AI work — DOI, archive, provenance, SEC, GLEIF, Wikidata, MOLIT Korean apartment prices, +11. Free 100 calls/day per IP — Pro $29/mo unifies with vivory-mcp-korea (55 tools, 100+ total) on one key.

environmentVariables.name: VIVORY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Vivory Pro API key for higher daily limits (10,000/day Pro vs 100/day anonymous). Get one at api.vivory.app/dashboard.

environmentVariables.name: VIVORY_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the upstream gateway URL (default: https://api.vivory.app/api). Useful for self-hosted Vivory backends.
